comment: RugSnare drift-watch corpus (research chat, 3-day cadence). 'pinned' = approved baseline contract; 'lastSeen' = latest version already graded; 'lastFindings' = findings count at last diff (for delta tracking). Each run: npm view latest; if > lastSeen -> install pinned, rugsnare scan, install latest, rugsnare diff; update docs/servers/<name>.md + this manifest. Dummy env values are for contract capture only, never call real APIs. Advance a pin deliberately, never silently. 2026-10-24 run: 14 servers re-diffed (mongodb/sap-fiori latest installs retried ok), skills superpowers@7.0.1 (303 files) + vercel-skills@a80e4c9 (226 files) re-pinned. 2026-10-25 run: 6 movers (hostinger 3.10.3, netlify 1.21.0, browserstack 2.2.8, sap-fiori 1.15.16, reference everything/filesystem 2.0.1); skills unchanged. 2026-10-30 run: 13 movers (busiest window); launchdarkly opened up 1->16; notion control lost its zero (1 identity finding); supabase pinned-scan failed on the 0.8.3 entry (queued for manual fix); bybit trading-mcp not found on npm from the history scanner (investigating); vercel-skills re-pinned at 92a9a34 (257 files). 2026-10-31 run: 5 movers; heroku control broke 1->33 (patch 1.2.13 drops additionalProperties:false from all 33 tool schemas); browserstack 33->42 (BREAKING accessibility pair; 46->52 tools); supabase 0.8.3 pinned scan recovered on a fresh stand (29 tools), 9->11; hostinger stable 40 through 3.24.1; sap-fiori stable 4 through 1.15.20; bybit trading-mcp confirmed delisted from npm (registry document 404). 2026-11-07 run (6-day window, quiet bus): 12 npm movers - busiest yet; sentry exploded 3->76 (toolkit #1374 split shipped: 9->76 tools); iterable re-graded 62->19 on a fresh stand; superpowers v7.0.2 = 15 findings, 7 DANGEROUS (subagent-driven-development suite rewritten); vercel-skills moved 92a9a34->d3701c1 but skills tree clean; bybit still delisted.
